templates.description: A simple yet powerful CI/CD engine with great extensibility, built for containers. Source: https://github.com/woodpecker-ci/woodpecker
templates.name: woodpecker-ci
templates.note: Woodpecker requires a forge and will not start until one is configured. Register a GitHub OAuth app (Authorization callback URL: <your WOODPECKER_HOST>/authorize) and paste the Client ID and Secret above. To use Gitea, Forgejo, GitLab or Bitbucket instead, edit the stack's WOODPECKER_* forge variables. See https://woodpecker-ci.org/docs
templates.title: Woodpecker CI
